title: Citation & bibliography

body.text: The AI helps with the tedious citation work:
convert reference lists between formats (APA, MLA, Chicago, Vancouver)
and check the consistency of the whole bibliography.

example: "Convert these 20 references from APA 7 to Vancouver, ordered by the sequence they're cited in the text"

title: A trap to watch out for

body.text: don't have the AI 'find' citations for you — it may invent references that don't exist (hallucinated citations)
. Use the AI only to format references you actually have; for finding sources, use Google Scholar or a real database.

example: "Fine: 'Format this entry in APA' / Risky: 'Find 10 papers about X to cite' (you may get fakes)"

question: How does the AI safely help with citations?

options.text: Generating a brand-new reference list for you
A reference the AI invents but that doesn't actually exist

question: Where should you find real sources?

options.text: Google Scholar or a real academic database
Have the AI make them up

question: What's the trap of AI citations to watch out for?

options.text: The AI may invent fake sources; you must check every time

question: What should you do with a reference list the AI gives you?

options.text: Verify each one actually exists and is correct
